theorem lg_target (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : a / b + b / c + c / a ≥ 3 := by
  let terms := [a / b, b / c, c / a]
  have h_pos : ∀ x ∈ terms, 0 < x := by
    intro x hx
    cases hx
    exact (ereal.div_pos ha hb).trans (ereal.div_pos hb hc).trans (ereal.div_pos hc ha)
  have h_am_gm : (terms.sum / 3) ≥ (terms.prod)^(1/3) :=
    real.arith_mean_ge_geom_mean h_pos (by simp [terms.prod])
  rw [mul_one, pow_one] at h_am_gm
  exact mul_le_mul_right h_am_gm (three_pos)
